title: 5 Facebook Ad Formats You Need 🤯
transcript: Here are the five Facebook ad formats that you need. Format No. 1 is authority ads. Show expertise and build trust. Make people believe in your product instantly. Format No. 2 is U D C. Driven ads. This is real people, real reactions, and social proof that converts. Format No. 3 demo based ads. Show the product in action and make it impossible for your audience to ignore. Format No. 4 problem solution based ads. You're going to hit the pain point. Show your product solving it in a clear and simple solution. Format No. 5 is lifestyle based ads. Paint the picture, show your product as a part of their dream lifestyle. Test them, scale them, and watch your real eyes take off.
